objective: Support reference-condition time normalization, not Top3 or future race prediction.
source: Preserved complete-normal quality-view extract; 2017 through 2026-09-19, all field sizes, exact 1000/1110m; previous artifacts and DB read-only.
pairs: Same official horse, exact distance, adjacent retained races, same year/month, each gap7..30days; include changed and unchanged band. Changed-band counts previously inspected only for support, not effects.
returns: Three adjacent retained same-horse same-distance races, same calendar year, each gap7..30days, total<=60days, outer bands identical. Include A-A-A controls and A-B-A changes. Primary response middle time minus date-linear interpolation of outer times. Entire-month-equal subset is fixed sensitivity. Linear ability and seasonal change cancel by interpolation; nonlinear changes remain.
model: Separate distance and design. Fixed-scale Huber ridgealpha1, reused converged damped-Newton solver. Pair band dummy differences, return middle minus interpolated outer dummies. Nuisance: gap or total/asymmetry gap, carried-weight/log-observed-starts/field-size/race-number contrasts, grade/sex dummy contrasts, ending or middle calendar-month indicators. Train-only weighted scaling; later/middle race equal fit weights. No finish-time outcome truncation. Endpoint abilities not assumed constant beyond local interpolation.
periods: Full2017..2026 descriptive; fit2017..2023 frozen before confirmation; confirmation2024..2025; 2026partial separate. Pair and triple endpoints all must lie inside each period. Previously reused historical data, no independent future-validation claim.
uncertainty: 200 fixed84-day-block full refits each full/confirmation distance/design; 100 horse-cluster full refits fullperiod. Blocks keyed later/middle date, overlapping observations and cross-block dependence remain. Pointwise95% quantiles, no multiplicity or selection uncertainty. Preserve convergence status and all draws.
direction: For each unordered band contrast report both chronological directions separately, nuisance-adjusted and sign oriented higher-band minus lower-band. Show support, do not choose favorable direction.
frozen_checks: Apply pair-estimated pre2024 moisture slopes at fixed rates0,25,50,100% to held pairs and held returns. Nuisance models refit only pre2024 per rate/design. Evaluate group conditional residual disparities across ordered transition groups and MAE secondary. Group support>=10unique later/middle races, fixed before estimates. Group-weighted centered RMS of mean race residual is descriptive bias proxy, not true counterfactual error; no rate selected from held outcomes. Triple A-A-A control environmental adjustment zero by construction.
sensitivity: Pairs7..21days, same grade and <=1kg difference; returns allsame-month, grade unchanged and middle weight within1kg of interpolation; OLS; pre2024 versus2024..2025 versus2026; latest old month-curve curvature diagnostic for broad returns, no refitting old model and not independent evidence.
monthly_scope: This followup isolates moisture first. Compare return interpolation curvature under prior month curve; no new universally adopted monthly coefficients.
adoption: Report estimates and corroboration/conflict. No automatic fixed rate selection, deployment, DB/schema/model writes. Do not equate observational repeated-race agreement with causal identification. Save all raw endpoint IDs/SHA, code, support, estimates, locked past coefficients, held diagnostics, uncertainty, verification and report; update conclusions.
